5KU Station – A Lively Street-Style Dining Experience in Ho Chi Minh City! 🇻🇳🍻

If you’re looking for an affordable dining experience with a lively atmosphere in Ho Chi Minh City, 5KU Station is worth checking out!

Located along Thai Van Lung Street in District 1, this restaurant stands out with its industrial-style décor, colourful graffiti walls, open-air seating and eye-catching neon signage. It offers a casual, energetic setting that is perfect for gathering with friends over food and drinks.

🍖 A Unique Street-Style Setting

One of the highlights of 5KU Station is its distinctive street-style environment. The exposed concrete walls, graffiti artwork, hanging lights and open dining area create a trendy yet relaxed atmosphere.

I particularly enjoyed the casual, street-style setting, which gives the restaurant plenty of character and makes dining here a different experience from a conventional restaurant.

😊 Friendly Staff, but Ordering Can Be Challenging!

We did encounter some challenges understanding the menu because of the communication difficulties. To their credit, the service staff were incredibly patient, waiting for us as we thought, guessed, asked questions, and finally figured out what we wanted to order! 😂

Their friendliness and patience certainly made the experience more enjoyable.

One thing to note: Be prepared to queue during peak hours, as the restaurant can get busy. Arriving earlier may help you avoid a long wait.

💰 Reasonable Prices, Great for Groups

Another plus point is the pricing. The food and drinks are very reasonably priced, making 5KU Station an attractive option for those who want to enjoy a casual meal without spending too much.

It is particularly suitable for groups of friends looking for an informal place to eat, drink and catch up.

⭐ My Overall Verdict

5KU Station offers a lively atmosphere, a distinctive street-style setting and very reasonable prices. Although we experienced some difficulty understanding the menu, the staff were friendly, helpful and wonderfully patient with us.

My Highlights: 🏙️ Atmosphere: Unique, lively and full of street-style character. 😊 Service: Friendly, helpful and patient despite communication difficulties. 🍽️ Menu: Some difficulty understanding the available dishes. 💰 Price: Very reasonable and budget-friendly. ⏳ Waiting Time: Expect queues during peak hours. 👥 Best For: Friends, groups and casual dining.

Overall, I enjoyed the experience at 5KU Station! The combination of its street-style ambience, affordable prices and patient staff made it a worthwhile dining experience in Saigon.

If you appreciate a lively atmosphere and affordable food, this is a place worth considering when visiting Ho Chi Minh City. Just be prepared for a possible queue, and don't be surprised if ordering becomes a little adventure of its own! 😂🇻🇳

Nice staff with table grill in rustic atmosphere
Sep 2024 • Couples
We had dinner at 5ku Station today. After reading the map, we decided on shrimp, octopus and fish stomachs. Since we didn't know exactly what to expect with the last dish, we were curious. Then came the charcoal table grill for the ordered food, the fish stomach looked quite nice on the plate and we thought this was his normal fish. Far from it, it was actually fish stomachs that resumed their original shape on the grill. We tried a piece and then it was clear that this is not for us.
The waitress noticed that we don't really like the ordered fish stomach and took it back with us and didn't calculate it, just great, because we had ordered this.
All in all a nice experience with the barbecue at the table, the ambience is Vietnamese, but the service just super nice, for this 5 points with star.

The best meal I've ever had!
Mar 2024 • Friends
Absolute recommendation! We went to this restaurant, which is located in a kind of inner courtyard, based on a recommendation from friends. Cool music is playing and the walls are decorated with graffiti. The waiters are really likeable and have a cool demeanor. We Germans can definitely learn a lesson from the speed. The recommendation there is a table grill. You order individual dishes such as meat and vegetables and grill them yourself. Simply delicious! It was also nice to see how, besides us, only local groups of friends or families ate in this restaurant and, unlike other restaurants, stayed for a long time. Because of the “inner courtyard feeling”, I was excited about the toilets and was surprised there too. They were as modern and clean as seldom found in the area. I recommend everyone who is in Ho Chi Mingh City to pay this restaurant a visit! The two of us paid €26 and only managed half of it. First there was a bowl of nuts seasoned with honey and chilli.

Vietnamese Barbecue
Mar 2024 • Friends
First of all, the restaurant is more than rustic, the chairs and tables are hand-made, the floor is bare concrete; the air is quite smoky due to the various table grills.
The restaurant is always busy, however, as it is comparatively cheap.
The barbecue itself is an experience, you grill yourself at your table on small charcoal grills, we tried beef and pork, both very nicely marinated and nicely flavorful!
In conclusion, it's not for a quiet dinner for two, but if you like grilled food and a good beer, you're in good hands here.
